policyPreview: Preview: {count, plural, one {# artifact would be removed} other {# artifacts would be removed}} ({freed})
agePolicySaveFailed: Failed to save package age policy
ageGateSaveFailed: Failed to save age gate settings
keyChangedWarning: Changing the key will update all URLs for this repository. Existing client configurations will need to be updated.
descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the purpose of this repository...
publicAccessHint: Public repositories allow unauthenticated read access.
quotaHint: Maximum storage for this repository. Leave empty for no limit.
uploadSizeHint: Maximum size for a single artifact upload. This limit is set instance-wide by an administrator on the Settings page and applies to every repository.
versioningHint: Keep an immutable revision history for artifacts in this repository. Re-uploading a path with different content appends a new revision instead of overwriting; prior revisions stay downloadable from the artifact's Versions tab.
versioningToggleHint: Applies to future uploads. Turning this off stops recording new revisions; existing history remains addressable.
rpmWillRemove: Trusted key will be removed when you save.
debianHint: Proxy distro/component/architecture filters and Release-file metadata.
npmHint: Restrict which npm scopes and names resolve through this repository.
agePolicyHint: Hold freshly published packages in quarantine for a cooldown period after their release. New releases pulled from upstream are not served until the window passes, giving time to flag a compromised release before it reaches clients.
enableAgePolicyHint: Quarantine packages released within the cooldown window.
ageInvalid: Enter a cooldown period of at least one {unit}.
ageHint: Packages released less than this long ago are quarantined.
ageGateHint: Withhold upstream releases younger than a minimum age until they mature or an admin approves them from the age gate review queue.
enableAgeGateHint: Queue too-new releases for admin review instead of serving them to clients.
ageGateInvalid: Must be a whole number between {min} and {max}.
ageGateValidHint: Releases published fewer than this many days ago are withheld. 0 disables the age delay but keeps admin rejections enforced.
proxyCacheHint: How long the proxy keeps cached upstream artifacts before re-validating against upstream. Applies repository-wide; per-artifact eviction is available from the artifact details dialog.
cacheInvalid: Must be a whole number between {min} and {max}.
scanningHint: Vulnerability scanning and inline scan-and-block for this repository. When blocking is on, artifacts that violate the policy are actively prevented from being downloaded rather than only flagged after the fact.
enableScanningHint: Turn vulnerability scanning on for this repository.
scanOnUploadHint: Scan artifacts as they are published to this repository.
scanOnProxyHint: Scan upstream artifacts inline as they are proxied through this repository.
blockOnViolationHint: Actively block downloads of artifacts that violate the severity policy, instead of only recording a finding.
severityHint: Findings at or above this severity count as a policy violation.
failClosedHint: Fail closed: if the scanner is unavailable or an inline scan can't confirm the artifact is clean, the download is blocked. Security first — a proxy outage can interrupt availability.
failOpenHint: Fail open: if the scanner is unavailable or an inline scan can't confirm the artifact is clean, the download is served anyway. Availability first — an unscanned artifact can slip through.
failClosedDisabledHint: Enable scanning and "Scan on proxy download" to choose the fail-open / fail-closed behavior.
cleanupPoliciesHint: Lifecycle policies that automatically remove old or unused artifacts.
noPolicies: No cleanup policies configured for this repository.
noPoliciesHint: Cleanup policies can be created from the Lifecycle section in the administration panel.
pluginGenericHint: Custom layout provided by a WASM plugin (generic family)
deletePolicyDescription: Are you sure you want to delete the "{name}" policy? This will not affect any previously cleaned artifacts.
